title: Basic Finance & Accounting
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado el vocabulario esencial de finanzas y contabilidad.

parts.visual: Revenue (Ingresos / Ventas totales): El dinero que entra a la empresa. Expenses (Gastos): El dinero que sale (renta, salarios). Profit (Ganancia / Beneficio): Lo que queda cuando los ingresos son mayores que los gastos. Loss (Pérdida): Cuando los gastos son mayores que los ingresos.
parts.audio: Revenue is the total money that comes into the company. Expenses are the money that goes out, like rent and salaries. Profit is what remains when revenue is greater than expenses. Loss happens when expenses are greater than revenue.

parts.visual: Budget (Presupuesto): El plan financiero. Invoice (Factura): Un documento que pide el pago por un servicio o producto. Taxes (Impuestos): Dinero que se paga al gobierno. Debt (Deuda): Dinero que se debe a otros (la 'b' es muda: se pronuncia 'det').
parts.audio: Budget is the financial plan. An Invoice is a document asking for payment. Taxes are money paid to the government. Debt is money owed to others. Note that the letter B in Debt is silent. You pronounce it: det.

questions.question: Our total ____ for the year was two million dollars. (Ingresos/Ventas totales).
We need to reduce our ____. We are spending too much on travel. (Gastos).
The company made a huge ____ this quarter! We earned more than we spent. (Ganancia).
Unfortunately, the company suffered a ____ last year. (Pérdida).
questions.explanation: Loss = pérdida (cuando los gastos superan los ingresos).

questions.question: What is our marketing ____ for this year? (Presupuesto).
The company is in ____. It owes a lot of money to the bank. (Deuda).
We have to pay income ____ to the government. (Impuestos).
We are over ____! We spent more than planned. (Pasados del presupuesto).
They ____ us $500 for the software. (Nos cobraron).
Have you ____ the invoice yet? (Pagado).
questions.explanation: Pay an invoice = pagar una factura.

questions.question: The ____ line shows our total profit or loss. (Línea de fondo / Resultado neto).
questions.explanation: Bottom line = el resultado neto (la última línea del estado financiero).

questions.question: We need to cut ____ to survive. (Recortar gastos/costos).
The accounting department handles ____. (Nómina/Pago a empleados).
questions.explanation: Payroll = nómina (el proceso de pagar salarios).

questions.question: Gross profit is before ____. (Bruto es antes de impuestos).
questions.explanation: Gross profit = ganancia bruta (antes de impuestos).

questions.question: Net profit is after ____. (Neto es después de impuestos).
questions.explanation: Net profit = ganancia neta (después de impuestos).

questions.question: You can request a ____ if you are not satisfied. (Reembolso).
Can you send me a ____ for the payment? (Recibo).
questions.explanation: Receipt = recibo (comprobante de pago). La 'p' es muda.

questions.question: I need to withdraw ____ from the ATM. (Dinero en efectivo).

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Our total revenue was two million.
options: Our total revenue was two million.
Our total profit was two million.
Our total expense was two million.
questions.correct_answer: Our total revenue was two million.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We need to reduce our expenses.
options: We need to reduce our expenses.
We need to cut our expenses.
We have to reduce our expenses.
We need to reduce the budget.
questions.correct_answer: We need to reduce our expenses.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The company made a huge profit.
options: The company made a huge profit.
The company made a big profit.
The company had a huge profit.
questions.correct_answer: The company made a huge profit.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Please pay the invoice within thirty days.
options: Please pay the invoice within thirty days.
Please pay the invoice in thirty days.
Please send the invoice within thirty days.
You must pay the invoice within thirty days.
questions.correct_answer: Please pay the invoice within thirty days.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We have to pay income taxes.
options: We have to pay income taxes.
We need to pay income taxes.
You have to pay income taxes.
questions.correct_answer: We have to pay income taxes.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Can you send me a receipt?
options: Can you send me a receipt?
Could you send me a receipt?
Can you give me a receipt?
questions.correct_answer: Can you send me a receipt?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
options: You can ask for a refund.
